Ana: Quick Q — can someone confirm the semantics we're shipping for prefix vs KV cache headers? I'm seeing two headers in responses and want to standardize clients.

Mike: Which headers? you mean the new X-Redwood-Prefix-Hit vs X-Redwood-KV-Hit?

Ana: yeah. Current plan: upstream adds X-Redwood-Prefix-Hit: 1|0, X-Redwood-KV-Hit: 1|0 and X-Redwood-Cache-Key-V: v2 when keying scheme changes. Also Cache-Control should continue to be present for proxies.

Jules: From impl: prefix cache is 'best-effort' — we may return a stream or partial from cache. For streaming we can only set header once connection establishes; so we set header on initial response with 'X-Redwood-Prefix-Hit: partial' when we started with cached prefix but regenerate suffix.

Sam: Suggest using explicit values: HIT, MISS, PARTIAL. numbers are ambiguous. e.g.

```
X-Redwood-Prefix-Hit: PARTIAL
X-Redwood-KV-Hit: MISS
X-Redwood-Cache-Key-V: v2
Cache-Control: private, max-age=0, s-maxage=60
```

Kevin: Backcompat: older clients expect integer flags. We should map both. Add docs: clients should check for string tokens first, then fallback to 1/0.

Ana: For invalidation, what's the signal? We have /cache/purge and /cache/purge-prefix endpoints, plus a 'key_version' bump mechanism. If we roll model or prompt normalization we bump X-Redwood-Cache-Key-V.

Mike: Also add a response body field for downstream consumers who can't access headers (e.g., webworkers). Maybe embed "cache_signal": "PREFIX_PARTIAL" in the JSON envelope.

Jules: That risks violating current API contract. If we add body fields we must make them optional and feature-flagged per customer. Better to keep headers as primary and add envelope only behind opt-in.

Sam: One more gotcha: CDN/proxy may strip warnings. Make sure Cache-Control still has 'no-transform' for important cases where we rely on exact bytes for cache keys.

Kevin: Also need to document how we derive the prefix key: normalized_prompt + model_id + temp_bucket. Example in docs.

Ana: OK action items:
- @Jules add 'PARTIAL' for prefix header handling for streaming (PR)
- @Mike add fallback mapping integers->strings in SDK (PR)
- @Kevin draft docs for key derivation and bump semantics
- @Sam prototype optional response-envelope flag for customers behind proxies

deploy-bot: Deployment to prod/eng-runtime/prefix-cache-v2 succeeded :tada:

Mike: I'll pick up the SDK PR after lunch. :+1:

Jules: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/472

Ana: thanks all — I'll sync this into the API contract doc and add examples. If anyone thinks we should change value names now speak up.
